probes.check: The lifecycle probe checks that each recorded step runs in the phase Jolt's facts declare.

seeded_violation.description: Record Jolt's Trace+AssertFailed step from setup glue, in the systems phase, instead of from the diagnostics binding.

probes.check: The build-flags probe compares Jolt's ABI defines across every target that includes Jolt's headers, and calls JPH::VerifyJoltVersionID().

seeded_violation.description: Define JPH_DOUBLE_PRECISION on one glue target only, in the build fragment.

probes.check: The build-flags probe reads each target's RTTI setting from the CMake file API.

seeded_violation.description: Compile the job-system adapter's target with RTTI on.

adaptation_notes: The build fragment calls find_package(Jolt CONFIG REQUIRED), links Jolt::Jolt, and compiles glue that derives from Jolt classes with -fno-rtti (MSVC /GR-).

Setup glue runs Factory and RegisterTypes, then creates one PhysicsSystem with two object layers (non-moving, moving) mapped to two broad-phase layers, a TempAllocatorImpl, and the jobs adapter from the jolt--jobs binding.
The layer tables are placeholders the game replaces; setup glue creates no bodies.
Shutdown destroys the PhysicsSystem before UnregisterTypes and deleting the Factory.
